Pensamento lógico e solução de problemas compl exos; Proficiência em alguma linguagem de programação (Python, Java e outras) e SQL: Ser capaz de usar essas linguagens de programação para manipular e gerenciar d ados; Conhecimento em tecnologias de big data: Familiaridade com ferramentas que permitem o processamento de grandes volumes de d ados; Experiência com sistemas de gerenciamento de banco de d ados: Saber como projetar e manter bancos de dados eficientes. Organização para gerenciar grandes volumes de dados e processos crít icos; Habilidades de resolução de problemas e pensamento analí tico: Capacidade de identificar e resolver problemas complexos de dados. Habilidade de documentação e boas práticas em arquitetura de d ados; Monitorar custos e performance em Redshift/Big Query/Athena, propondo ajustes de partição, compressão e cac hing; Habilitar testes de qualidade de dados e observabilidade end-to-end nos pipelines crít    icos. Stack desej ável: Redshift, Big Query, Snowflake, Athena, Iceberg, Delta Lake; Spark (Data Frames, Structured Streaming), Flink, EMR, Dataproc, Databricks, Hadoop (YARN, HDFS); Apache Ni Fi, Kafka Connect, AWS DMS, Kafka, Kinesis, Pu b/Sub; Airflow, Prefect, Dagster, Open Telemetry, Data Hub, Great Expecta tions; Terraform/Ia C, CI/CD Git, testes de dados automatizados, segurança LGPD (IAM fine-grained, encryption at rest/in tra    nsit). Design, model, and coordinate fire sprinkler and fire suppression systems for commercial and residential U. S. projects. Apply NFPA standards (particularly NFPA 13, 14 & 20) to develop fully compliant, constructible designs. Perform clash detection and spatial coordination with Mechanical, Electrical, Plumbing, and Structural disciplines using Navisworks . S. You will work as a dedicated, full-time member of our client's team, collaborating directly on real-world U. S. projects while Cresta supports your ongoing onboarding and HR experience.      Ready to model safer projects for the US market? Apply now and elevate your career!  Note: Only CVs submitted in English will be reviewed.

title: Supervisor técnico de tubulação
description:

Sobre a Gruen      Fundada no Brasil em 2020, com sede em São Paulo, a Gruen conta com um time de engenharia atuando tanto localmente quanto na Alemanha o que assegura o desenvolvimento do processo mais eficiente para cada projeto. Nossa missão é entregar a melhor tecnologia para purificação de biogás com o menor consumo de energia entre todos os processos disponíveis no mercado.    Nossas soluções são específicas e feitas sob medida de acordo com a necessidade dos nossos clientes: pré-tratamento do gás, remoção de CO2 e N2, optional CO2 capture and storage ou liquefação, Liquefação de CH4 ou compressão de 250bar – desde o projeto inicial até a gestão da operação da planta, garantindo satisfação total de nossos clientes.    Fabricação e assistência técnica locais resultam em redução de custo e aumento de eficiência.    Soluções para contratos de manutenção e operação das plantas viabilizam a redução da complexidade e de custos.    Nossa motivação é desenvolver soluções viáveis na geração de energia limpa e sustentável para a preservação do nosso planeta e das gerações futuras.      Supervisor Técnico de Tubulação      Atribuições Coordenar e fiscalizar as equipes terceirizadas responsáveis pela montagem de tubulações e equipamentos. Planejar e acompanhar a execução das atividades de campo, garantindo o cumprimento dos prazos e metas do projeto. Verificar a conformidade dos serviços executados com desenhos, isométricos, especificações técnicas e procedimentos de montagem. Acompanhar a instalação de tubulações, suportes, válvulas, acessórios e equipamentos associados aos sistemas de gás. Garantir o cumprimento dos requisitos de Saúde, Segurança, Meio Ambiente e Qualidade (SSMA/QSMS), promovendo uma cultura de trabalho seguro. Realizar inspeções de campo, identificar desvios e implementar ações corretivas para assegurar a qualidade da execução. Coordenar a interface entre as equipes de engenharia, planejamento, inspeção, segurança, operação e empresas contratadas. Acompanhar testes de pressão, estanqueidade e demais atividades de comissionamento relacionadas aos sistemas de tubulação. Controlar o avanço físico das obras, elaborar relatórios técnicos e registrar ocorrências relevantes. Validar medições dos serviços executados pelas empresas terceirizadas, quando aplicável. Apoiar a resolução de problemas técnicos durante a execução das atividades, buscando soluções que minimizem impactos no cronograma. Assegurar a correta utilização de materiais, equipamentos e recursos disponibilizados para a obra. Participar de reuniões de acompanhamento com clientes, fornecedores e empresas contratadas, apresentando o status das atividades e os principais indicadores.    Qualificações Cursos técnicos em Mecânica, Tubulação Industrial ou áreas correlatas. Experiência em coordenação e fiscalização de empresas terceirizadas de montagem industrial. Vivência em projetos de redes de distribuição de gás, gasodutos, city gates ou plantas industriais. Conhecimento em leitura e interpretação de desenhos técnicos, P& ID, isométricos e fluxogramas. Conhecimento das normas ASME B31.3, ASME B31.8, API 1104, NR-13, NR-33, NR-35 e demais normas aplicáveis ao setor. Experiência com testes hidrostáticos, pneumáticos, testes de estanqueidade e atividades de comissionamento. Conhecimento em planejamento e controle de obras, gestão de cronogramas Habilidade em liderança, negociação, tomada de decisão, resolução de conflitos e gestão de equipes terceirizadas. Domínio do Pacote Office e familiaridade com sistemas de gestão de manutenção, obras ou ERP será considerado um diferencial. title: Arquitetura de soluções azure - 134713
description:
Confira a vaga para Arquitetura de soluções azure - 134713 em remote. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

O que buscamos:    Profissional de nível Arquitetura que atue com Cloud Azure) para atuação remota e contratação CLT.    Responsabilidades:   Fundar o ambiente Azure dentro do ecossistema multicloud do Zero Layer Platform, projetando o modelo de isolamento entre células (shard key, blast radius e static stability) e implementando o Control Plane (shard map, registro de tenants e lifecycle de células). Implementar o Zero Layer Router (autenticação, TLS e lookup do shard map) e o Zero Layer Router Kafka (isolamento de tópicos por tenant), definindo estratégia de autenticação sem lock-in (OIDC, m TLS). Definir engines relacionais e não relacionais por célula, projetando sharding alinhado ao tenant key, com réplicas, failover e criptografia em repouso e trânsito de forma agnóstica ao provider. Estabelecer padrões de Ia C (Terraform) com módulos reutilizáveis por célula e desenhar pipeline CI/CD completo (lint, plan, gates de aprovação, apply e drift detection), suportando o ciclo completo da célula (criação, atualização, re-shard e destruição rastreável). Provisionar AKS por célula com isolamento de rede e Network Policies, projetar topologia de VNet (subnets, peering, conectividade cross-cloud) e gerenciar ciclo de vida de certificados TLS de forma automatizada. Implementar autenticação com provider agnóstico (OIDC/OAuth 2.0), configurar identidades gerenciadas sem segredos estáticos e estabelecer RBAC por célula com princípio de menor privilégio. Implementar estratégia de observabilidade por célula (métricas, logs e traces distribuídos), operando Datadog como plataforma principal (APM, Log Management, dashboards e alertas baseados em SLO), garantindo rastreabilidade ponta a ponta com correlation IDs. Documentar decisões em ADRs e diagramas de arquitetura.    Requisitos Obrigatórios   Azure em produção: AKS, VNet, bancos gerenciados, mensageria e IAM Capacidade de discutir e implementar Cell-Based Architecture Terraform para Ia C multi-célula com pipelines de CI/CD para infra Kubernetes em produção: rede, RBAC, Helm e autoscaling Redes: DNS, TLS/PKI, firewalls e roteamento em cloud Mensageria: Kafka ou equivalente em contexto de roteamento assíncrono Bancos relacionais e não relacionais em contexto de sharding Padrões de autenticação: OIDC, OAuth 2.0 e identidades gerenciadas Observabilidade em produção: métricas, logs e traces distribuídos.    Desejável:   Experiência prévia com Cell-Based Architecture em produção Visão multicloud: workloads simultâneos em Azure e AWS Argo CD (Git Ops), incluindo Application Sets para deploy em múltiplas células Service mesh (Istio, Cilium) e m TLS inter-serviço Datadog: APM, Log Management, SLO tracking e alertas por célula Certificações: CKA, AZ-305, Terraform Associate ou equivalentes.    Descrição comportamental:    Procuramos uma pessoa que:   Goste de trabalhar em equipe e seja colaborativa em suas atribuições; Tenha coragem para se desafiar e ir além, abraçando novas oportunidades de crescimento; Transforme ideias em soluções criativas e busque qualidade em toda sua rotina; Tenha habilidades de resolução de problemas ; Possua habilidade e se sinta confortável para trabalhar de forma independente e gerenciar o próprio tempo ; Tenha interesse em lidar com situações adversas e inovadoras no âmbito tecnológico. title: Cloud coe solution architect gcp
description:
Nova oportunidade para Cloud coe solution architect gcp em guararema. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

Cloud Co E Solution Architect GCP - Sao Paulo-Guararema      Mars is a $50 B+ global powerhouse driving the next generation of digital transformation. We are a family-owned business operating in 80+ countries with over 150,000 Associates. Guided by our Five Principles— Quality, Responsibility, Mutuality, Efficiency, and Freedom —we are currently embarking on a massive Digital Core program to modernize our global technology landscape and build the future of our enterprise cloud capabilities.      When you join Mars, you join a purpose-driven company where we’re striving to build the world we want tomorrow, today.      The Opportunity    As a Cloud Center of Excellence (CCo E) Solution Architect , you will play a critical role in driving the design, architecture, and delivery of cloud solutions for the entire organization. You will collaborate with a global team of architects to develop and implement Mars’ platforms and cloud-based systems that power our operations every day.    Working within the CCo E Client Solutions team, you will act as a bridge between cloud architects, enterprise architecture, security, and business stakeholders. Your mission will be to develop services, establish landing zones, and design secure, scalable architectures for high-impact, unique digital projects.      Key Responsibilities    In this role, you will balance technical excellence with collaborative enablement. Your day-to-day responsibilities will include:   Architectural Design & Blueprinting: Assess business demands and technical requirements to create robust, highly available, and fault-tolerant Low-Level Designs (LLDs). Infrastructure as Code (Ia C): Lead the implementation of cloud solutions utilizing modern Ia C practices (Git, Terraform) to automate and scale deployments. Scalability & Performance: Design and architect systems that support elasticity, ensuring cost-optimizations and peak performance. Security & Compliance: Ensure all solutions align strictly with the Mars Cloud Adoption Framework, Security Principles, and Well-Architected Frameworks. Collaboration & Leadership: Act as the Single Point of Contact (SPOC) in the CCo E for customer LLD/Deployment Projects, guiding cross-functional design discussions and contributing to the service catalog's evolution. Cloud Advocacy: Act as a Cloud Ambassador across Mars, promoting cloud adoption, sharing best practices, and mentoring other technical teams.    What We Are Looking For    Core Technical Skills & Experience (Must-Haves): Proven GCP Expertise: Hands-on experience architecting and deploying enterprise-grade solutions on Google Cloud Platform (GCP) and its primary services. Infrastructure as Code (Ia C): Strong experience deploying cloud infrastructure via Terraform and managing workflows with Git. Solution Design & Integration: Deep proficiency in application architecture, system integration, data modeling, and designing for high availability/disaster recovery. Software Engineering Foundation: In-depth knowledge of modern software development principles, methodologies, and enterprise architectures. Security Mindset: Practical understanding of cloud security principles, identity and access management (IAM), data protection, and compliance standards.  Leadership & Soft Skills: Stakeholder Management: Experience translating complex technical concepts into clear business value for both technical and non-technical audiences. Problem-Solving: Exceptional analytical and structured problem-solving skills with a track record of driving clarity in ambiguous environments. Collaboration: Proven ability to work effectively in cross-functional, multicultural, and global teams.    Nice-to-Haves: Experience with other major cloud platforms (such as Microsoft Azure or AWS). Familiarity with enterprise architecture frameworks (e.g., TOGAF). Professional GCP certifications (e.g., Professional Cloud Architect, Professional Cloud Security Engineer).    What to Expect in This Role Balancing Speed and Governance: The Cloud Co E is an enabler, not a bottleneck. Your success means building robust landing zones that protect our enterprise systems while empowering developers to innovate at pace. Complex Multi-Stakeholder Collaboration: You will regularly coordinate between software developers, security officers, and business leaders. Clear, jargon-free communication is your primary tool for aligning vision.    What Can You Expect from Mars? Collaborative Culture: Work with diverse, talented, and highly supportive Associates, all guided by the Five Principles. Continuous Learning: Access to best-in-class learning and development support from day one, including our in-house Mars University and specialized cloud certification pathways. Competitive Compensation: An industry-competitive salary and comprehensive benefits package, including a performance-based company bonus. Global Impact: The opportunity to work on projects that directly influence a global scale, touching millions of lives every day.    Equal Opportunity Employer    Mars is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.    If you need assistance or an accommodation during the application process because of a disability, it is available upon request. The company is pleased to provide such assistance, and no applicant will be penalized as a result of such a request.

Requisitos Técnicos Mínimos Arquitetura e operação em ambientes multi-cloud (AWS, GCP e/ou OCI); Infraestrutura como Código — Ia C (Terraform ou equivalente); Pipelines de CI/CD (Git Hub Actions, Git Lab CI, Argo CD ou similares); Conteinerização e orquestração (Docker e Kubernetes); Segurança em nuvem: IAM, gestão de vulnerabilidades e conformidade; Machine Learning aplicado: treinamento, validação e implantação de modelos.    Requisitos Técnicos Desejáveis / Diferenciais Agentic AI / LLM Ops — agentes de IA para automação de workflows; AIOps — detecção de anomalias e monitoramento inteligente; Fin Ops — otimização de custos em nuvem e Predictive Autoscaling; Policy-as-Code (Open Policy Agent, Sentinel ou similares); Arquiteturas de auto-healing e failover automatizado multi-cloud; Publicações acadêmicas em Dev Sec Ops, MLOps ou infraestrutura autônoma. title: Promo writer (brasil)
description:
Nova oportunidade para Promo writer (brasil) em remote. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

Promo Writer    Location: Remote    Position Type: Contract    Company: Pocket FM    About Us    At Pocket FM, our mission is to deliver immersive storytelling experiences to a global audience. We are looking for a creative and detail-oriented Junior Writer to support content localization, AI-driven script adaptation, and storytelling optimization across our audio series.    Role Overview    As a Promo Writer, you will be responsible for creating high-impact promotional scripts for Pocket FM audio series. These promo scripts will be used for performance marketing campaigns across various platforms, including Meta and UAC, and will later be moved into post-production for final execution.    The role requires a strong understanding of ad creation, trailer writing, promo structuring, storytelling hooks, audience retention, emotional pacing, and localized content adaptation. You will write fresh promotional ads from scratch, adapt existing ads from the English team into Brazilian Portuguese, localize them for the target audience, and refine existing ads to improve quality and performance.    You will work closely with creative, editorial, production, and performance marketing teams to deliver production-ready promo scripts and suggest rework hypotheses for non-performing ads.      Key Responsibilities     1. Promo, Trailer & Ad Script Writing Write fresh promotional ad scripts from scratch for Pocket FM audio series. Create engaging long-form promo scripts, typically ranging from 30 to 60 minutes, designed to drive listener interest and campaign performance. Develop strong hooks, emotional beats, cliffhangers, character moments, and narrative setups that make the audience want to start listening to the series. Write scripts that are clear, engaging, and suitable for audio-first post-production. Ensure each promo script reflects the core promise, genre, tone, and audience appeal of the series. 2. Adaptation & Localization Adapt promotional scripts and ad concepts shared by the English team into Brazilian Portuguese. Localize scripts culturally and emotionally so they feel natural and relevant for the Brazilian audience. Maintain the original creative intent while improving clarity, relatability, and audience engagement for the local market. Ensure adapted ads do not feel like direct translations, but like native, market-ready promotional scripts. 3. Script Refinement & Quality Improvement Review and refine existing promo scripts to improve overall storytelling quality, pacing, emotional impact, and clarity. Strengthen weak openings, hooks, transitions, character motivations, and call-to-action moments. Improve scripts based on editorial feedback, performance insights, and creative direction. Ensure all final scripts are polished, coherent, and aligned with Pocket FM’s creative and quality standards. 4. Production-Ready Script Delivery Create production-ready promo scripts with clear structure, scene flow, dialogue, narration, emotional cues, and production notes wherever required. Ensure scripts are easy for voice-over artists, editors, and post-production teams to understand and execute. Provide clear direction on tone, pauses, dramatic moments, sound cues, and emotional delivery where needed. Support the production team by ensuring the script intent is preserved during execution. 5. Performance Reworks & Creative Hypotheses Analyze non-performing ads and suggest creative hypotheses for improvement. Recommend reworks based on possible issues such as weak hooks, unclear story setup, low emotional impact, poor pacing, or ineffective localization. Create alternate openings, revised structures, stronger cliffhangers, and improved audience entry points for underperforming promos. Collaborate with marketing and creative teams to test different ad angles and improve campaign performance. 6. Creative & Editorial Collaboration Work closely with editorial, production, localization, and performance marketing teams. Incorporate feedback quickly and deliver revised scripts within timelines. Maintain consistency in character, tone, story logic, and emotional continuity across promo assets. Contribute ideas for new promo formats, trailer structures, and ad angles that can improve audience response. 7. AI Tool Usage & Workflow Optimization Use Gen AI and writing tools where required to support ideation, adaptation, translation review, and script refinement. Apply strong human editorial judgment to ensure AI-assisted work meets narrative, cultural, and quality standards. Review AI-generated outputs for tone, accuracy, cultural relevance, and storytelling strength. Use AI tools responsibly to improve speed and quality without compromising creative originality.      Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Literature, Creative Writing, Media, Communications, Journalism, Film, or a related field. Strong writing and storytelling skills, especially for audio, ads, trailers, promos, or digital content. Excellent command of Brazilian Portuguese, with strong understanding of local cultural nuances, expressions, and audience preferences. Good understanding of English, with the ability to adapt English scripts and concepts into natural Brazilian Portuguese. Strong sense of narrative structure, emotional pacing, character motivation, hooks, and cliffhangers. Experience in promo writing, ad scriptwriting, trailer writing, fiction writing, audio storytelling, content localization, or digital performance creatives is preferred. Ability to write production-ready scripts with clear directions for voice-over and post-production teams. Ability to analyze feedback and performance signals to improve creative output. Strong attention to detail and ability to maintain quality across multiple deliverables. Comfortable working in a fast-paced content and performance marketing environment. Familiarity with AI-based writing, translation, or content adaptation tools is a plus.      Ideal Candidate    The ideal candidate is a strong storyteller who understands how to turn an audio series into a compelling promotional experience. They should know how to grab attention quickly, build emotional curiosity, create drama, and write scripts that make audiences want to listen further.    They should be equally comfortable writing original promo scripts, adapting English ads into Brazilian Portuguese, refining existing scripts, and suggesting creative reworks for ads that are not performing well.

title: Regional sales manager, brazil (chinese speaking)
description:
Confira a vaga para Regional sales manager, brazil (chinese speaking) em remote. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

Job Overview    We are looking for a country manager with entrepreneurial spirit and strong results orientation, responsible for building and leading the company's business in the LATAM region from scratch. This is a unique high-impact position suitable for sales leaders who crave challenges and autonomy. You will be responsible for developing market entry strategies, establishing key partnerships, building high-performance sales teams, and driving significant revenue growth. Your success will be directly rewarded through an unlimited commission structure.      Main responsibilities Partnership Development : Proactively identify, approach, and build strong relationships with strategic partners, affiliates, communities, and key opinion leaders (KOLs). Maintain high outreach velocity and continuously expand a quality partner network. Business Growth & KPI Achievement : Drive regional performance by improving key commercial metrics related to customer acquisition, engagement, and overall revenue contribution. Deliver measurable business impact through disciplined execution and performance tracking. Full BD Process Ownership : Independently manage the entire BD lifecycle - prospecting, qualification, negotiation, follow-ups, closing, and post-deal maintenance. Ensure fast execution and a healthy pipeline. Client & Partner Relationship Management : Build and maintain long-term, trust-based relationships with partners. Increase engagement, retention, and contribution through proactive and high-frequency communication. Market Research & Competitive Insights : Monitor regulatory updates, competitor strategies, user behaviour, and market dynamics in the LATAM region. Provide actionable insights and identify new partnership opportunities. Localized Marketing Collaboration : Work closely with marketing teams to support localized content, community engagement, and event initiatives. Ensure smooth and effective execution across Portuguese-speaking markets.re all sales and partnership activities comply with local regulations and company policies.    Job requirements (must be met) Minimum 2-3 years of experience in sales or business development, capable of independently acquiring and converting clients. Strong execution, self-discipline, and ability to work effectively in a remote, fast-paced environment. Excellent communication skills with the ability to maintain long-term relationships and manage high-frequency partner interactions. Good command of English and Portuguese for business communication (Mandarin proficiency is a strong plus). High resilience and emotional stability under pressure and rejection. Existing partner, affiliate, community, or KOL resources that can contribute value in the short term. Experience in digital platforms, online services, fintech, or other performance-driven industries, or strong personal familiarity with similar ecosystems. Strong hunter mindset: bonus-driven, results-oriented, and motivated by performance-based outcomes.    We provide Uncapped Income Potential: An attractive compensation package that includes a generous base salary and more importantly an uncapped commission structure that directly rewards your performance. Autonomy and Influence: Freedom to form your own team and develop strategies for the entire region. Your decisions will directly affect the global success of the company. Career Development: This is a senior leadership position where you will have great career and financial advancement opportunities as the company grows. Global Environment: Work with a diverse international team to serve customers worldwide. Remote work flexibility: can work from anywhere in the world.

title: Sales assistant

US holidays Health insurance refund. Fully remote. Growth opportunities.

title: Executive producer

Revisar todas as estimativas e propostas antes de sua aprovação e envio. Liderar a gestão de alterações de escopo, custos adicionais (overages) e demais impactos financeiros dos projetos. Colaborar com as equipes de Atendimento da Studio Rx no planejamento anual de escopo de trabalho (Scope of Work). Desenvolver estratégias de planejamento e alocação de recursos para maximizar a utilização das capacidades do estúdio. Experiência em produção digital será considerada um diferencial. Excelente capacidade de organização, planejamento e resolução de problemas. Atenção excepcional aos detalhes. Perfil flexível, orientado a processos e capaz de lidar com múltiplas demandas e diferentes fontes de informação simultaneamente. Excelente comunicação verbal e escrita, com habilidade para apresentar ideias de forma clara e objetiva. Perfil proativo, colaborativo, ágil e orientado para soluções. Capacidade de manter a calma, tomar decisões e liderar equipes em ambientes dinâmicos e de alta pressão. title: Criador de conteúdo sem experiência :: apostas esportivas & igaming
description:

Gravar vídeos curtos (formato reels/shorts) usando apenas um celular, seguindo as diretrizes fornecidas pela Doppa. title: Regional sales representative
description:

SC — Regional Sales Representative    Quectel | LATAM | Sales & Business Development      Position Details    Job Title: SC — Regional Sales Representative    Department: Sales & Business Development — LATAM    Reports To: Regional Sales Manager / Director, LATAM    Location: Santa Catarina, Brazil    Work Arrangement: Hybrid — with regular field visits across the assigned territory    Employment Type: Full-Time    Travel Required: Frequent travel across Santa Catarina and the LATAM region (customer visits, trade shows)      Role Overview    The SC — Regional Sales Representative will be a key growth driver for Quectel LATAM, responsible for maximizing Quectel's market share in the region on Non-Cellular product lines (e.g., GNSS, Wi-Fi & Bluetooth, satellite communication, antennas) and new market segments. This will be achieved through a dedicated focus on market analysis and by winning new verticals and customers centered on these product lines.    Acting as the face of Quectel in Santa Catarina, this professional will map and develop the full commercial potential of the territory — prospecting new customers, engaging underserved segments, and ensuring that every technology company in the region knows Quectel and its affiliate solutions.      Key Responsibilities Understand the needs and expectations of customers and provide relevant, solution-oriented recommendations. Prospect every new customer who uses any technology solutions within the assigned territory. Maintain a high volume of client and partner engagement, ensuring a minimum of 10 meetings per week while sustaining consistent productivity standards. Map and develop the full commercial potential of the assigned territory — going beyond well-known business clusters to identify and engage new client prospects and underserved market segments. Follow up on account designs for the assigned product lines within the Regional Funnel. Train the Quectel Sales Force and Rep Firms/Distributors on the assigned product lines and follow up on resulting opportunities. Create a Monthly Territory Discussion Report covering leads, technical evaluations, meeting plans, roadmap calls, and related activities. Operate CRM (customer relationship management) systems and ensure authentic, up-to-date information is available within the company. Visit exhibitor booths at trade shows to identify accounts and products that use cellular modules and obtain contact information. Ensure 100% of technology customers in the region/state get to know Quectel and its affiliate solutions.    Qualifications & Requirements    Required Experience: Minimum of 3 years in sales positions within the Io T segment. Educational Background: Bachelor's Degree or equivalent in Electronic Engineering, Computer Science, Automation, Electronics & Communication, or other IT-related fields. Communication Skills: Excellent verbal and written communication skills in Portuguese and English. Customer-Centric: Demonstrated ability to understand and align solutions with customer business goals. Location: Based in Santa Catarina, Brazil, with availability for frequent travel across the territory.    Preferred Knowledge of non-cellular technologies such as GNSS, Wi-Fi & Bluetooth, Lo Ra, satellite communication, and antennas. Existing relationships with OEMs, design houses, system integrators, or distributors in Southern Brazil. Experience selling into smart metering, asset tracking, smart agriculture, industrial Io T, or connected mobility verticals. Proficiency with CRM tools (e.g., Salesforce, Hub Spot) and standard productivity software. Spanish language skills a plus.    About Quectel    Quectel is a global Io T solutions provider and the world's leading supplier of cellular and GNSS modules, with a mission to build a smarter world. Our broad portfolio spans cellular modules (5 G, LTE, LPWA), GNSS, Wi-Fi & Bluetooth and satellite communication modules, antennas, and Io T connectivity services — combined with outstanding support and services that shorten our customers' time-to-market.      With engineering, sales, and support teams across APAC, EMEA, North America, and LATAM, Quectel serves a rapidly growing base of Io T innovators worldwide. Together with ecosystem affiliates such as Acceleronix (Io T platform and Connectivity-as-a-Service), Quectel enables end-to-end solutions from module to cloud.      Life at Quectel LATAM    At Quectel LATAM, no two days are the same. You'll collaborate with a diverse, globally-connected team, engage directly with some of the most innovative OEMs and enterprises in Latin America, and contribute to technologies that are redefining how devices and people connect.     Fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment backed by the resources of the global leader in Io T modules. Direct access to global R& D, product, and engineering teams across Asia, Europe, and the Americas. Regular knowledge-sharing through internal trainings, webinars, and cross-functional project teams. A culture of continuous learning — we invest in your growth because your development is our development.    Industries & Applications    Quectel's Io T solutions power innovation across a wide range of industries. As part of our team, you'll have the opportunity to make a real impact in:     Smart Metering & Utilities — Electricity, water, and gas metering solutions. Asset Tracking & Logistics — Fleet management, cold chain, and supply chain visibility. Smart Agriculture — Precision farming, greenhouse monitoring, and livestock tracking. Smart Cities & Infrastructure — Street lighting, parking, public safety, environmental monitoring. Industrial Io T & Automation — Predictive maintenance, factory automation, condition monitoring. Connected Mobility & Automotive — Telematics, EV charging, micro-mobility. Smart Home & Consumer Io T — Connected appliances, energy management, security.    Why Quectel LATAM? Global Impact, Regional Focus — Be at the forefront of Io T innovation across Latin America, backed by the global market leader with teams in APAC, EMEA, and North America. Career Growth & Development — Access structured mentorship, international exposure, internal mobility, and clear advancement paths within a fast-growing global organization. Cutting-Edge Technology — Work with next-generation GNSS, Wi-Fi & Bluetooth, satellite, antenna, and cellular technologies deployed in mission-critical applications. Diversity & Inclusion — Join an inclusive, multicultural workplace where diverse perspectives are valued as key drivers of innovation and success. Global Team & Collaboration — Collaborate with a global network of Io T experts across engineering, sales, marketing, and operations — and with the Quectel ecosystem, including Acceleronix.    Compensation & Benefits Competitive base salary aligned with LATAM market benchmarks. Performance bonus / sales commission structure. Flexible meal and grocery vouchers (meal allowance / food allowance). Health insurance with no co-pay. Life insurance. Paid time off. International travel opportunities (HQ visits, global trade shows).    Explore Quectel — Links & Resources    We encourage all candidates to learn more about Quectel before applying. The links below will give you a full picture of who we are, what we build, and what it's like to work here.    Company & Careers    Company Website: — Global Io T solutions provider    Quectel Careers: — Open roles across the Quectel ecosystem    Quectel News & Press: — Latest company announcements    Acceleronix (Ecosystem Affiliate): — Io T platform and connectivity services    Follow Us on Social Media    Linked In: Quectel Wireless Solutions — Company updates, job posts, industry news    You Tube: Quectel on You Tube — Product demos, tech talks, and event highlights    Technical & Developer Resources    Quectel Developer Zone: developer. — Docs, SDKs, tools, and developer support    Product Selector: — Browse the full portfolio of Io T modules and antennas    Quectel is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or any other legally protected characteristic.

title: Director of strategic partnerships
description:
Confira a vaga para Director of strategic partnerships em remote. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

ABOUT ELIFE    Elife is the unified API infrastructure behind global mobility and instant delivery across 182 countries. We power Super Apps, Fin Techs, neobanks, and ride-hailing ecosystems worldwide — we don't compete with them, we enable them. Our partners integrate once and serve their users globally. We build and operate the infrastructure. Our partners own the brand and the customer relationship. We do not compete for our partners' users.      THE ROLE    We are looking for a proven ecosystem hunter — not an account manager, not a loyalty program builder, not a co-marketing specialist. Someone who has personally closed bidirectional commercial deals where both parties share live transaction revenue, through API integrations with super apps, neobanks, fintech platforms, or mobility companies.    This is a greenfield, individual contributor role. You will build elife's LATAM pipeline from zero, own the full deal lifecycle from outreach to signed contract, and be expected to deliver active pipeline within the first 90 days.      WHAT YOU WILL DO Identify, engage and close strategic partnerships with super apps, neobanks, fintech platforms, ride-hailing operators and e-commerce ecosystems across LATAM Own the full commercial lifecycle — outreach, negotiation, deal structuring, contract execution and partner onboarding Structure and close revenue-share and API integration agreements where elife's infrastructure powers mobility and delivery services inside a partner's platform Build and maintain 20+ active enterprise prospects at any given time Engage C-suite and VP-level decision makers directly — no intermediaries Represent elife at industry events and forums across LATAM Report pipeline, forecasts and market intelligence directly to the VP of Partnerships    WHAT WE NEED — NON-NEGOTIABLE 8+ years of B2 B enterprise partnerships experience Minimum 3 years of direct experience closing ecosystem deals with or inside super apps, neobanks, fintech platforms, or ride-hailing companies in LATAM Proven track record closing bidirectional revenue-share deals — where revenue is generated by live transactions, not loyalty points, discount campaigns or co-marketing budgets Direct experience structuring and closing API integration partnerships commercially — owning the business case, commercial terms and deal execution end-to-end Active C-suite network verifiable with specific names in at least two of the following: Rappi, Uber, Di Di, Mercado Pago, Nu, Clip, Stori, Kavak, i Food or equivalent LATAM super apps or neobanks Multi-country LATAM experience — Mexico and/or Brazil required; Colombia, Argentina, Chile a plus Hunter DNA — you have built pipelines from zero, not inherited them Fluency in Spanish and/or Portuguese required; English proficiency required Bachelor's degree minimum; MBA strongly preferred    PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS Prior experience working with or for mobility platforms, ride-hailing operators, corporate travel or fleet technology companies Track record closing first-of-kind or complex ecosystem partnerships with measurable commercial outcomes Experience managing partnerships across multiple LATAM countries simultaneously Familiarity with the regulatory and payments landscape across Brazil, Mexico and Colombia    WHAT WE OFFER Fixed monthly base + KPI bonus scalable up to 300% based on commercial results Uncapped commissions tied directly to the revenue you generate Remote-first with regional travel as required Direct access to C-suite and founder leadership from day one A genuinely entrepreneurial environment where your deals shape elife's growth trajectory in LATAM    MARKET CONTEXT    Latin America is one of the fastest-growing digital financial services markets in the world, led by Brazil and Mexico. The region is home to a dynamic ecosystem of super apps, neobanks, and ride-hailing operators actively seeking scalable mobility and delivery partnerships. The Director of Strategic Partnerships for LATAM will build elife's presence from the ground up in this high-potential, relationship-driven market — and earn accordingly.

title: Service product sales engineer (energy storage)
description:
Nova oportunidade para Service product sales engineer (energy storage) em são paulo. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

Summary As an Overseas Service Sales Engineer, you will be responsible for promoting and selling the company's energy storage operation and maintenance service products in designated overseas markets. You will directly engage with end customers, channel partners, and project developers to drive the signing and execution of service contracts. A deep understanding of customer needs is essential to provide tailored solutions leveraging the company's service product strengths. You will collaborate closely with internal technical, project, and support teams to ensure customer success, contribute to achieving regional sales targets, and strengthen the company's competitiveness in the overseas energy storage services market.Key Responsibilities: Sales Target Execution & Client Development: 1.1. Execute team-defined regional service product sales strategies and action plans. Actively develop new clients and maintain existing client relationships to achieve individual sales targets (e.g., contract value, collection rate). 1.2. Independently manage the full sales cycle from opportunity identification, service requirement analysis, solution presentation, and negotiation to the signing of service contracts (e.g., LTSA, ASSA), with a focus on long-term service projects for energy storage plant O&M, operations, and asset management. Customer Insight & Solution Customization: 2.1. Conduct in-depth research on customer pain points, industry standards, and policy environments in key overseas target markets (e.g., Europe & Americas, APAC). Provide timely feedback on market trends and competitive intelligence. 2.2. Collaborate with the Solution Department to provide customers with suitable O&M service product portfolios (e.g., extended warranty, remote monitoring, preventive maintenance, performance optimization, assessment, supplementation). Lead technical discussions and service proposal presentations. Key Account & Channel Collaboration: 3.1. Assist the Sales Manager in maintaining relationships with regional strategic key accounts and channel partners. Participate in joint visits, technical workshops, and commercial negotiations. 3.2. Explore ecosystem partnership opportunities (e.g., with EPC contractors, energy operators) to expand service product coverage through partner networks. Cross-functional Collaboration & Project Support: 4.1. Work closely with Product, Project Management, Technical, and Service Delivery teams to ensure service solution feasibility. Facilitate smooth handover post-contract signing and track customer satisfaction. 4.2. Regularly relay customer feedback to internal teams, providing frontline input for service product optimization. Sales Process & Data Management: 5.1. Strictly utilize the CRM system to record sales activities, update pipeline data, and maintain customer information, ensuring forecast accuracy and process compliance. 5.2. Participate in team sales reviews. Analyze data to summarize win/loss experiences and market obstacles, supporting team strategy adjustments. Compliance & Risk Management: 6.1. Adhere to company overseas business compliance policies and local laws & regulations. Ensure contract terms and commercial activities meet risk control requirements. Promptly report potential risks. Qualifications: Must-to-Have: Bachelor's degree or higher. Engineering (Electrical, Energy, Automation, etc.) or Business background preferred. Minimum 3 years of B2 B sales experience. Experience in service sales within new energy, energy storage, power, or industrial services preferred. Experience in overseas markets (especially Europe & Americas, Australia/New Zealand, Japan/Korea) is a plus. Familiarity with fundamental service technologies for energy storage systems, O&M/operations processes, or plant asset management models. Ability to communicate customer service needs effectively with technical teams. Proven track record of independently achieving sales targets. Practical experience in selling service-type products (e.g., subscription-based, long-term agreements) is required. Proficient in using CRM and office software; possesses basic data analysis skills. Fluent in English and Local Language (written and spoken). Knowledge of Chinese is a plus. Soft Skills & Attributes: Customer-centric & Solution-oriented:Skilled at uncovering latent customer needs, translating product value into customer language, and providing targeted solutions. Self-driven & Resilient:Capable of proactively driving work in a goal-oriented, cross-time-zone collaborative environment. Maintains resilience under performance pressure. Cross-cultural Communication & Collaboration:Adapts to multicultural environments. Able to build trust and collaborate effectively with overseas clients and internal global teams. Learning & Adaptability:Stays attuned to changes in energy storage industry technology and business models. Quickly grasps new product and service logic. Integrity & Compliance Awareness:Upholds business ethics. Strictly adheres to company compliance processes, safeguarding the company's brand reputation. Additional Notes: This position requires frequent travel (approximately 30%-50% of the time) to cover designated overseas regional clients and project sites. The company provides product training, sales methodology coaching, and overseas market resource support to facilitate employee growth.

title: Solution engineer
description:
Empresa está contratando Solution engineer em são paulo. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

O Solution Engineer é o responsável por desenhar soluções técnicas e arquiteturas de alto nível a partir de demandas da área comercial, garantindo que as propostas apresentadas aos clientes sejam tecnicamente viáveis, padronizadas, reutilizáveis e alinhadas às capacidades reais dos times técnicos da empresa. Atua predominantemente após a qualificação comercial, entrando quando já existe um escopo inicial mais claro, com o objetivo de transformar necessidades de negócio em soluções arquiteturais bem fundamentadas, que possam ser implementadas de forma eficiente pelos times de desenvolvimento. O Solution Engineer trabalha sob a liderança do Tech Manager, em colaboração próxima com Tech Leads, apoiando a definição de arquiteturas, avaliando riscos técnicos, promovendo reutilização de componentes e garantindo coerência entre o que é proposto ao cliente e o que será efetivamente entregue. Embora não seja responsável direto por estimativas de esforço, o Solution Engineer apoia ativamente o processo de estimativa, validando junto ao Tech Lead e ao Tech Manager se a solução proposta é compatível com prazos, complexidade e riscos esperados, promovendo iterações no desenho da solução sempre que necessário.Principais Responsabilidades 1. Desenho de Soluções e Arquitetura ● Desenhar soluções técnicas e arquiteturas de alto nível a partir de demandas comerciais e necessidades do cliente. ● Propor arquiteturas alinhadas aos padrões técnicos da empresa, priorizando reutilização de componentes, simplicidade, escalabilidade e manutenção. ● Utilizar diferentes níveis de abstração e modelagem conforme o público-alvo (ex.: diagramas de contexto, arquitetura lógica, C4 quando aplicável). ● Garantir que as soluções propostas estejam alinhadas às diretrizes técnicas definidas pelo Tech Manager. ● Considerar, no desenho das soluções, diferentes ambientes de infraestrutura (cloud pública, cloud privada e on-premises), bem como restrições técnicas e operacionais do cliente.2. Padronização e Reutilização ● Atuar, em conjunto com o Tech Manager, como guardião dos padrões de solução e arquitetura reutilizáveis. ● Incentivar o uso de componentes, módulos e abordagens já existentes ou planejadas pela engenharia. ● Contribuir para a construção e evolução de um catálogo de soluções e componentes reutilizáveis da empresa.3. Interface com Comercial ● Apoiar a área comercial na construção de propostas técnicas, apresentações e esclarecimentos junto aos clientes. ● Avaliar a viabilidade técnica das demandas comerciais antes da formalização da proposta. ● Sinalizar riscos, limitações e trade-offs técnicos, escalando decisões críticas para o Tech Manager quando necessário. ● Atuar como facilitador técnico entre comercial e engenharia, evitando promessas inviáveis.4. Apoio a Estimativas e Viabilidade ● Trabalhar em conjunto com Tech Leads e Tech Manager para validar se o desenho de solução está compatível com: ○ esforço estimado, ○ complexidade técnica, ○ riscos e dependências. ● Promover ajustes no desenho da solução quando identificados riscos excessivos ou desalinhamentos entre escopo e capacidade técnica. ● Garantir que o que é apresentado ao cliente esteja alinhado com a realidade de execução do delivery.5. Handoff e Acompanhamento Inicial do Delivery ● Conduzir o handoff formal e estruturado da solução para o time de delivery, garantindo transferência completa de contexto, premissas, riscos e decisões. ● Atuar de forma colaborativa com o time técnico no início do projeto, esclarecendo dúvidas e validando a aderência da implementação à solução proposta. ● Assegurar que eventuais ajustes necessários no início do delivery sejam devidamente alinhados e documentados.6. Comunicação e Documentação ● Produzir documentação clara e objetiva das soluções propostas, incluindo arquiteturas, premissas, riscos e decisões. ● Elaborar apresentações técnicas para clientes e stakeholders, adaptando linguagem e profundidade conforme o público. ● Garantir rastreabilidade das decisões técnicas tomadas durante a fase de solução.Habilidades e Competências Essenciais Hard Skills ● Forte capacidade de desenho de soluções e arquiteturas de software, considerando diferentes contextos de infraestrutura e integração. ● Conhecimento sólido de ambientes de cloud pública (ex.: AWS, GCP, Azure), com capacidade de avaliar serviços, trade-offs e custos. ● Capacidade de considerar, quando necessário, cenários de cloud privada e ambientes on-premises, respeitando restrições técnicas, operacionais e de segurança dos clientes. ● Conhecimento de arquiteturas baseadas em mensageria e comunicação assíncrona, incluindo eventos, filas e processamento desacoplado. ● Familiaridade com os principais serviços e tecnologias oferecidos porprovedores de infraestrutura, incluindo diferentes tipos de: ○ bancos de dados (relacionais, No SQL, analíticos), ○ storage (objetos, blocos, arquivos), ○ mecanismos de integração e mensageria. ● Capacidade de dialogar tecnicamente com engenheiros, Tech Leads e Tech Manager, avaliando viabilidade, riscos e trade-offs das soluções propostas. ● Capacidade de produzir documentação arquitetural e apresentações técnicas de forma clara e estruturada.Soft Skills ● Comunicação clara com públicos técnicos e não técnicos. ● Capacidade de traduzir necessidades de negócio em soluções técnicas viáveis. ● Pensamento crítico para identificar riscos e trade-offs cedo. ● Postura colaborativa entre comercial e engenharia. ● Organização, atenção a detalhes e disciplina na documentação. ● Capacidade de lidar com múltiplas demandas e priorizar com pragmatismo.

A SYSTRA é um dos principais grupos de engenharia e consultoria do mundo, especialista em transporte público e mobilidade sustentável. Com mais de 11.000 colaboradores, nossa missão é projetar soluções seguras e inovadoras que aproximem pessoas, promovam inclusão social e facilitem o acesso ao emprego, à educação e ao lazer em todo o mundo. Há mais de 65 anos, o Grupo atua ao lado de cidades e regiões para desenvolver, modernizar e operar infraestruturas e sistemas de transporte, acompanhando todas as fases do ciclo de vida dos projetos. Estamos presentes em mais de 80 países, incluindo o Brasil, que conta com mais de 800 colaboradores. No Brasil, nossa história começa nos anos 1960, com estudos para a modernização da rede ferroviária e as primeiras análises para implantação de metrôs. Nas décadas seguintes, participamos de projetos que viabilizaram metrôs, VLTs, BRTs e rodovias. A SYSTRA Brasil entrega soluções completas em todas as etapas: estudos, desenvolvimento de projetos, gerenciamento e fiscalização. Hoje, também apoiamos nossos clientes e parceiros na transição digital, ecológica e energética, sempre com foco na mobilidade do futuro. Para maiores informações acesseNa SYSTRA, além de contribuir com conhecimento e ideias inovadoras, você terá a oportunidade de trabalhar em um time de referência global, conectado por um propósito comum: transformar a mobilidade com excelência, audácia e colaboração. Aqui, você terá contato com diversos projetos de mobilidade e infraestrutura de transportes, em um ambiente que valoriza o aprendizado contínuo e o desenvolvimento de cada profissional. A confiança transporta o mundo, e para nós isso significa criar um ambiente onde todas as pessoas possam pertencer e crescer. Nossas vagas são inclusivas e abertas à diversidade de talentos que movem a mobilidade do futuro.Principais Atividades:Realizar levantamentos técnicos de campo dos sistemas de telecomunicações existentes, verificando a condição instalada, localização, identificação e estado operacional dos equipamentos. Identificar e documentar equipamentos, painéis, racks, cabeamentos, fibras ópticas, infraestrutura, interfaces e interligações entre os diversos sistemas. Executar inspeções e testes básicos de funcionamento, quando autorizados, visando confirmar a operação dos equipamentos e a consistência das informações levantadas. Levantar informações dos sistemas existentes, incluindo, entre outros: Sistema de Transmissão; Rede Óptica; Sistema de Telefonia; Sistema de Rádio; Sistema de Sonorização; Sistema de Informação ao Passageiro; Sistema de CFTV; Sistema de Controle de Acesso; Sistema de Cronometria/Sincronismo; Sistema SCADA de Telecomunicações e demais sistemas correlatos. Registrar características técnicas dos equipamentos, fabricantes, modelos, versões, capacidade instalada, interfaces de comunicação e demais informações relevantes. Confrontar a documentação existente com a condição efetivamente instalada, identificando divergências, equipamentos desativados, modificações e ausência de documentação. Elaborar registros fotográficos, croquis, listas de equipamentos, inventários, planilhas e demais documentos necessários ao levantamento. Apoiar a elaboração de relatórios técnicos, listas de ativos, inventários, diagramas simplificados e demais documentos de engenharia. Atuar em conjunto com equipes de operação, manutenção e demais disciplinas durante as atividades de campo, respeitando os procedimentos operacionais vigentes. Executar as atividades observando rigorosamente os requisitos de segurança para atuação em ambiente metroferroviário em operação.Requisitos técnicos desejáveis:Formação técnica em Telecomunicações, Eletrônica, Eletrotécnica, Automação, Redes de Computadores ou áreas correlatas. Experiência em levantamento de campo, instalação, manutenção ou comissionamento de sistemas de telecomunicações. Conhecimento em um ou mais dos seguintes sistemas: CFTV; Rede Óptica; Transmissão de Dados; Telefonia; Rádio; Sonorização; Controle de Acesso; Informação ao Passageiro; Cronometria; SCADA/BMS aplicado aos sistemas de telecomunicações. Conhecimento em cabeamento estruturado, fibras ópticas e infraestrutura de telecomunicações. Capacidade para interpretação de diagramas unifilares, esquemas funcionais, plantas, layouts, listas de cabos e documentação técnica. Experiência na elaboração de registros técnicos e inventários de equipamentos. Capacitação em NR-10 e demais treinamentos aplicáveis às atividades em campo. Conhecimento em Auto CAD e desenho técnico, com capacidade para leitura, interpretação e elaboração de plantas, layouts e detalhamentos técnicos.

O que você fará ·Liderar tecnicamente o time de desenvolvimento com visão estratégica e execução prática ·Transformar demandas de produto em soluções técnicas claras, detalhadas e estimadas ·Planejar e estruturar Sprints, considerando prioridades, capacidades e complexidades ·Estabelecer e garantir padrões de qualidade, arquitetura e boas práticas ·Realizar code reviews, validar soluções técnicas e tomar decisões arquiteturais ·Identificar riscos, dependências e bloqueios, propondo mitigações proativas ·Desenvolver e orientar pessoas, realizando feedbacks e acompanhando performance ·Ser a principal referência técnica e mentor do time ·Identificar e direcionar melhorias e débitos técnicos de forma estratégica Seu Perfil Procuramos por um profissional sênior com forte domínio técnico, liderança natural e capacidade de comunicação. Não é uma posição focada em desenvolvimento hands-on, mas sim em planejamento, liderança, revisão e decisões técnicas. Características principais: ·Firme, organizado e com perfil natural de liderança ·Excelente comunicação com habilidade de influenciar decisões ·Proativo na identificação de problemas e soluções ·Capacidade de cobrar prazos, qualidade e responsabilidades ·Forte senso de ownership sobre o time e as entregas ·Hábil em feedback construtivo e desenvolvimento de pessoas Requisitos Técnicos ·PHP e Laravel (principal stack de desenvolvimento) ·My SQL e bancos de dados relacionais ·Java Script, HTML e CSS ·Arquitetura de APIs e integrações ·AWS (infraestrutura e cloud) ·Git e versionamento de código ·Docker e containerização Diferenciais (não obrigatório, mas desejado) Se você tem experiência com Saa S, sistemas de saúde, LGPD, sistemas de grande porte, ambientes com múltiplas integrações ou evolução de sistemas consolidados, isso será um grande plus! Experiência ·Mínimo 2 anos como Tech Lead liderando times de desenvolvimento ·Experiência comprovada em planejamento e acompanhamento de Sprints ·Sólido conhecimento em estimativas e detalhamento técnico ·Prática em Code Review e definição de soluções técnicas ·Experiência em gestão e desenvolvimento de pessoas ·

title: Delivery experience & capacity strategy expert
description:
Empresa está contratando Delivery experience & capacity strategy expert em são paulo. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

Job Responsibilities Fulfillment Experience:Take ownership of fulfillment experience goals (including On-Time Delivery rate, delivery speed, etc.). Design the fulfillment experience monitoring system, build diagnostic capabilities, and design and implement improvement strategies based on diagnostic results. Capacity Strategy:Responsible for the quantity and quality of fulfillment capacity. Design capacity models tailored to different stages of business development; formulate strategies for capacity acquisition (growth) and retention; design capacity management rules; and collaborate with stakeholders to drive implementation, building a competitive barrier in delivery capacity. Cost Optimization:Responsible for fulfillment costs. While maintaining experience standards, leverage strategies such as dispatching, pricing, and ETA in coordination with capacity models to improve delivery efficiency and optimize overall fulfillment costs. Operational Support:Support operational actions required for strategy implementation, including market research, frontline interaction, and information alignment.Job Requirements Education:Bachelor’s degree or above. Experience: Experience in internet platform operations, strategy analysis, or the logistics/delivery industry. Experience in strategy operations or capacity management within O2 O, On-demand Delivery, E-commerce Logistics, or Ride-hailing platforms is preferred. Core Competencies: Data-Driven:Excellent data analysis skills and sensitivity. Proficient in SQL and Excel, with the ability to discover problems and validate strategies through data. Logical & Systems Thinking:Clear logical thinking and systematic thinking capabilities. Able to deconstruct complex business problems and design actionable solutions. Project Management & Collaboration:Outstanding cross-departmental communication and collaboration skills. Able to effectively drive Product, Tech, and Marketing resources to achieve project goals. Ownership & Resilience:Strong sense of ownership for business results. Possess strong self-drive and the ability to solve problems in a fast-paced, uncertain environment.*Keeta Brazil is committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We welcome and encourage applications from people with disabilities (Pw D). If you require any accommodations during the recruitment process, please let us know - we are here to support you.
